changelog:
jedToolKit 27.0.1 introduces all-new jedAI Widgets for your Home Screen.

jedAI Widgets & Redesign: View recent conversations, titles, and timestamps directly from your Home Screen with adaptive layouts, clean card-style rows, tinted badges, and an expanded title style.

Live Sync & Reliability: Automatic real-time updates for new, updated, or deleted chats, alongside clearer error guidance for sync, installation, and sideloading issues.

This update is recommended for all users.
